protocol.diagnostics: One-sided exact binomial excess false-confirmation test at .05, Holm across requested sizes 1/10/32. Also report exact Monte Carlo intervals, null/alternative/undefined counts and simultaneous interval noncoverage. Non-rejection is not proof of control.
protocol.family_selection: Cycle requested size by seed offset modulo three. Freeze equally spaced ranks across the native S reconciliation order, including nonshortlisted candidates; size one uses the first rank. This stresses both adverse and nonadverse retained gates instead of taking only the strongest alternatives. If fewer exist, retain/report the actual family; never call it the requested size. No H or oracle selection.
protocol.population: Eight equiprobable Boolean feature cells; error .40 when a XOR b, otherwise .10. Labels are independent fair Bernoulli variables; supplied decisions flip on error.
protocol.scope: Reduced-profile partial-null families with correlated/overlapping gates; finite IID Bernoulli inference and explicit declared synthetic independence. No bootstrap, temporal/entity dependence, default-capacity or universal learner qualification.
protocol.truth: Exact rational member-minus-complement population risk, enumerating all eight cells with frozen gates. Null iff defined effect <= zero. Undefined truth or incomplete applicability is not silently called a true null.

scope: Reduced-profile partial-null D/S/H investigations on the eight-cell population only. Actual frozen families govern inference; smaller actual families do not qualify requested-size operation. Overlapping claims are not independent Monte Carlo trials. Non-rejection does not prove control or complete full-product/default-profile qualification.
